quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a behavioural finance platform that identifies and corrects an individual investor's personal biases.
quests.correctAnswer: It names your personal investing habits - like panic-selling or chasing last year's winner - and quietly builds guardrails before they cost you real money.
quests.hint: Name specific biases for instant credibility.
quests.explanation: Naming specific, recognisable habits shows real understanding and makes the pitch feel personally relevant.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family app that plans and budgets a multi-generational holiday everyone can actually afford.
quests.correctAnswer: Everyone sets their own budget, and the app finds a trip the whole family can enjoy without anyone quietly worrying about the bill.
quests.hint: Focus on removing the unspoken money worry.
quests.explanation: Naming an unspoken worry, not just logistics, is what makes a family planning tool feel genuinely thoughtful.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a multi-currency account built for freelancers who invoice clients in several countries.
quests.correctAnswer: Hold thirty currencies at once and convert at the real bank rate, so international clients stop costing you money just to get paid.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in the real-rate conversion and the zero extra cost.
quests.explanation: A concrete, verifiable saving on conversion rates is easy for any freelancer to immediately appreciate.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a school app that tracks a student's progress across every subject in one simple, visual dashboard.
quests.correctAnswer: One glance shows exactly where a student is thriving and where they need support, replacing a stack of separate report cards.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on clarity for a busy parent, not just data.
quests.explanation: Turning scattered data into one clear picture is what actually helps a busy parent act on it.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a private equity access platform allowing everyday sophisticated investors to co-invest alongside institutions.
quests.correctAnswer: Investors once locked out now co-invest alongside major funds, with the same deal terms that used to be invitation-only.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in previously invitation-only access.
quests.explanation: Opening previously closed deal flow is the classic democratisation pitch in private investing.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that sends a themed activity box for grandparents to enjoy with visiting grandchildren.
quests.correctAnswer: Every box turns a visit into a shared project, so grandparent and grandchild have something to actually do together, not just talk.
quests.hint: Focus on the shared activity, not the age gap.
quests.explanation: Giving two generations something to do together, not just discuss, deepens a bond in a very concrete way.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a travel insurance that pays out automatically the moment a flight delay passes a set threshold.
quests.correctAnswer: The moment your delay passes two hours, the payout lands automatically - no claim form, no dispute, no waiting on hold.
quests.hint: Lead with the claim-free, automatic payment.
quests.explanation: A claim-free process is a genuine reimagination of insurance and is instantly easy to remember.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a workplace app that lets colleagues in different offices share a virtual coffee break automatically scheduled each week.
quests.correctAnswer: A short, informal video chat lands on the calendar each week, so colleagues in different cities still feel like they work down the hall.
quests.hint: Open with connection, not just scheduling.
quests.explanation: Solving isolation, not just logistics, is what makes a simple scheduling feature genuinely valued by remote teams.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a climate risk insurance for farmers that uses satellite data to trigger automatic payouts before crops fail.
quests.correctAnswer: Satellite data triggers a payout the moment rainfall drops below a safe level - farmers are paid before the harvest fails, not after.
quests.hint: Start with paying before failure, not after.
quests.explanation: Paying before failure, rather than after, is a genuine improvement in how agricultural insurance actually protects people.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a shopping app that shows the true cost per wear of a clothing item before you buy it.
quests.correctAnswer: It divides the price by how often you're likely to wear something, so a cheap top that sits in the drawer suddenly looks expensive.
quests.hint: Reframe price as cost per use, not sticker price.
quests.explanation: Reframing price as cost per wear changes how a shopper actually values an item, not just its tag.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a fertility support app that helps couples track and understand their options with clear, judgement-free guidance.
quests.correctAnswer: Clear explanations and gentle tracking replace confusing forums, so couples make sense of their options without feeling judged at every step.
quests.hint: Begin with clarity and reassurance over raw data.
quests.explanation: Reassurance matters as much as information on a topic this personal, so leading with tone builds trust.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a robo-advisory platform specialising in portfolios built around personal values and sustainability goals.
quests.correctAnswer: It builds a fully diversified portfolio matched to your values, and reports the returns and the impact together, side by side.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in values alignment and dual measurement.
quests.explanation: Measuring returns and impact together tackles the old myth that doing good means giving up performance.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a family app that turns household chores into a fair, visible rotation everyone can see.
quests.correctAnswer: Every chore rotates fairly and visibly, so nobody's stuck secretly doing the dishes every night while everyone else forgets.
quests.hint: Name the specific, quietly unfair pattern this fixes.
quests.explanation: Naming a specific, quietly resented pattern makes a simple chore chart feel like real fairness, not nagging.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a wealth management platform built for clients whose income and assets span several countries.
quests.correctAnswer: It untangles the tax and reporting rules across every country your money touches, so complexity stops costing you sleep.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on untangling complexity, not just managing money.
quests.explanation: Naming complexity as the actual problem, not just wealth itself, speaks directly to what these clients lose sleep over.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a language app that prepares travellers for one specific real-world situation, like ordering at a restaurant abroad.
quests.correctAnswer: Instead of a whole language, learn exactly what you need for one real moment - ordering dinner with total confidence, in minutes.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in one real situation, not general fluency.
quests.explanation: Promising one confident moment, not full fluency, is a realistic goal that removes the fear of starting.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a home-repair marketplace that shows verified reviews only from neighbours on the same street.
quests.correctAnswer: See reviews only from people on your own street, so you know a tradesperson is trusted by someone you could actually bump into.
quests.hint: Lead with hyper-local trust, not general reviews.
quests.explanation: Hyper-local trust feels far more credible than an anonymous star rating from someone in another city entirely.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a thematic investment platform letting everyday investors build a portfolio around one long-term global trend.
quests.correctAnswer: Build a portfolio around one trend you actually believe in - clean energy, ageing populations - instead of just tracking an anonymous index.
quests.hint: Use specific, recognisable trend examples.
quests.explanation: Named, recognisable trends make an abstract investing idea feel concrete and personally chosen.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a school transport app that lets parents track a school bus in real time and get arrival alerts.
quests.correctAnswer: Watch the bus in real time and get an alert five minutes before it arrives, so waiting in the cold finally has an end time.
quests.hint: Picture the exact cold, uncertain wait this removes.
quests.explanation: A precise, uncomfortable scenario - the cold wait - makes an ordinary tracking app feel genuinely useful.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a cyber insurance platform that lowers your premium automatically as your actual security improves.
quests.correctAnswer: Better security, checked in real time, means a lower premium every month - insurance that rewards good habits instead of just charging for risk.
quests.hint: Open with the security-incentivised pricing.
quests.explanation: Pricing insurance to reward good behaviour aligns the interests of the insurer and the insured for once.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription box that sends a new outdoor family activity kit matched to the current season.
quests.correctAnswer: Winter brings a scavenger hunt kit, summer brings a camping kit - always matched to the season, so the excuse of 'wrong weather' disappears.
quests.hint: Start with removing the seasonal excuse.
quests.explanation: Removing a specific, common excuse - the weather - is what turns good intentions into an actual family outing.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a fee-transparent financial advisory service that charges by the hour with no hidden commission.
quests.correctAnswer: Advisors charge by the hour and earn nothing from what they recommend, so the advice is finally shaped by your interests, not theirs.
quests.hint: Begin with incentive alignment as the core argument.
quests.explanation: Incentive misalignment is the deepest source of distrust in financial advice, so naming it directly is compelling.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a moving company that packs, transports, and fully unpacks a home in a single day.
quests.correctAnswer: Boxes are packed in the morning and unpacked by evening, so moving day ends with an actual home, not a maze of boxes.
quests.hint: Contrast the usual weeks of boxes with a single day.
quests.explanation: Contrasting the usual drawn-out unpacking with a single finished day makes the value instantly easy to picture.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a genetic counselling service connecting people with certified counsellors over a video call.
quests.correctAnswer: A certified counsellor walks you through what your results actually mean, on your own schedule, without a months-long clinic waiting list.
quests.hint: Anchor the pitch in accessible expert guidance, not the test itself.
quests.explanation: Guidance matters more than raw genetic data, so leading with expert access builds far more trust than test details.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app that tracks a household's warranty documents and files a claim automatically when something breaks.
quests.correctAnswer: The moment something breaks, it checks the warranty and starts the claim itself, so a broken appliance is fixed, not just filed away and forgotten.
quests.hint: Focus on action taken automatically, not just storage.
quests.explanation: Taking action automatically, not just storing paperwork, is what turns a filing tool into something genuinely useful.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a tax calculator built specifically for remote workers who earn income across more than one country.
quests.correctAnswer: Enter where you worked and for how long, and it tells you exactly what you owe, and where, before any surprise letter ever arrives.
quests.hint: Centre the pitch on preventing a surprise, not just calculating.
quests.explanation: Preventing a stressful surprise is a stronger pitch than simply promising an accurate number.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a subscription that sends a new bedtime routine card each week to help toddlers settle without a fight.
quests.correctAnswer: One new, gentle routine each week, and bedtime slowly stops being the nightly battle it used to be.
quests.hint: Name the nightly struggle this gradually solves.
quests.explanation: Naming a genuinely exhausting nightly struggle makes a simple card gain real, specific meaning for tired parents.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a wealth platform that turns a client's charitable giving into a fully tax-optimised annual plan.
quests.correctAnswer: Every donation is planned to give both the charity and your own tax return the biggest possible benefit, without extra paperwork on your end.
quests.hint: Ground the answer in the dual benefit: charity and tax efficiency together.
quests.explanation: Solving two goals with one plan, giving and saving, is a genuinely efficient use of a client's money.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a travel app that finds accommodation within walking distance of everything on a traveller's must-see list.
quests.correctAnswer: Add your must-see list first, and it finds the one hotel that puts all of it within an easy walk, not a taxi ride.
quests.hint: Lead with walking distance as the whole point.
quests.explanation: Solving location around the traveller's actual plan, not just star ratings, is what real convenience looks like.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a robo-advisory platform giving retail investors the same portfolio tools once reserved for private bank clients.
quests.correctAnswer: The same tools a private bank once reserved for its wealthiest clients are now available to anyone starting with a modest amount.
quests.hint: Open with the democratisation of previously exclusive tools.
quests.explanation: Opening exclusive tools to a much wider audience is the clearest, most persuasive fintech story there is.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app that helps new parents split night feeds fairly and track everyone's actual sleep.
quests.correctAnswer: It tracks who took which night feed, so exhaustion gets shared fairly instead of quietly landing on the same parent every time.
quests.hint: Name the quiet unfairness around exhaustion this fixes.
quests.explanation: Naming an exhausting, often invisible imbalance is what makes a simple tracking app feel like real support.
